title: Voice Configuration
description: Local-first voice configuration for the Telegram transport. Both directions are disabled by default. A remote transcription or synthesis service moves user content off the machine and is therefore never enabled implicitly by the presence of a credential: it requires an explicit opt-in and passes the egress policy.

localEngine.description: Local transcription engine identifier. Attempted first whenever inbound voice is enabled.

optIn.description: Explicit acknowledgement that recordings leave this machine. A credential alone must never enable this.

credentialRef.description: Opaque credential reference. Never a raw key.

qualification.description: Deterministic rules deciding whether a reply is worth hearing.

maxCodeShare.description: Share of the text inside fenced code blocks above which no speech is produced.

diffLineThreshold.description: Count of genuine diff lines above which no speech is produced. Markdown bullets must not count.

maxClipSeconds.description: No single clip exceeds this. Longer replies are split at paragraph, sentence, line or word boundaries.

normalization.description: Optional model-backed rewrite so the text reads naturally aloud. Optional because it costs a model call per reply.

languageGuard.description: Reject a normalization pass that changed the language of the text and fall back to the un-normalized text.
